{{Quote|See him? That man’s a junk jockey. Swims in engine lubricant. Handles a wrench better than he handles a woman|Stellet to Khedryn Faal|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />>}}
'''Stellet''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Starfire (Stellet)|''Starfire'']]. He was a regular on the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and often engaged [[Khedryn Faal]], a salvage jockey, in friendly banter.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
